method: Executed headless on the unchanged ImageBufferDownload (bmc).a(BufferedImage), i.e. parseUserSkin. Each record: case, input size, input ARGB pixels (TYPE_INT_ARGB, big-endian ints, base64), output size/type and output ARGB pixels. Output is always a 64 x 32 TYPE_INT_ARGB (2) image; a null input returns null.
